schema: header40 + N ESDF float64 + N occupancy-code float64; code bit0 raw, bit1 inflated; x-major z-contiguous; world voxel-edge origin
interpretation: Exporter obtains occupancy and distance within one immutable Complete scope; diagnostic requires identical occupancy and ESDF observation sequences.
Raw/inflated occupancy is merged native map occupancy; codes do not identify static versus live source.
Diagnostic header stores body sphere count and joint timestamp but omits sphere positions and odometry; body collision needs separately aligned body and odometry.
No large dynamic_capture.bag was opened by this script.

summary.conclusion: Within these 16 diagnostic frames, recorded occupancy and signed ESDF are coherent, and the crop interior exactly matches independent EDT recomputation. This does not prove occupied cells correspond to real objects or rule out stale/incorrect occupancy elsewhere in time.
summary.remaining_geometry_requirement: Actual body geometry alignment completed in actual_body_clearance.json; future reference coefficients and the exact live occupancy layer used by FSM remain unavailable in this analysis.
